column1: # Golden id -> port pairs at the default range (PORT_BASE=20000 PORT_SPAN=1000).
# The mapping is a portable CRC (cksum), so these values are stable across
# machines and over time; the self-test asserts each id still maps here, which
# would catch any accidental change to the hashing that breaks determinism.
# Format: <worktree-id> <expected-port>. Blank lines and # comments ignored.
